basic_info.description: Lovely Victorian duplex zoned multi-family. Desirable Pacific Heights neighborhood. Located close to restaurants, coffee shops, Japan Center, Alta Plaza Park, UCSF Mt. Zion, etc.  Originally constructed prior to 1900, with an extensive remodel/addition completed in 1983, which included raising the structure to add 2 garages and a living space on the ground floor, new electrical, plumbing, heating, windows, etc. Recent freshening up'' including new flooring, floor covering, painting inside and out and more. Tenant in upper unit (3028); six years, quiet, low impact, always paid rent on time, unprotected class. Basement living space, which is attached to the lower unit (3024), has separate entry and Airbnb potential. Checking with the City of S.F. is advised. Short notice to view the lower unit and ground floor living space (3024) is okay. Upper unit requires 24 hours' notice (3028). Owned by the same family since the 1960s.
